description: Frozen RADAR preprocessing manifest for HBBMAAD. Reproduces data/radar_real_windows.csv and (with --include-metadata) the family-tagged variant. Raw-file hashes require the gated Zenodo download (DOI 10.5281/zenodo.14564541); the rest is fixed below.

dataset.name: RADAR: A Realistic Dataset for Advancing Ransomware Detection
dataset.authors: Ispahany, Islam, Khan, Islam (Charles Sturt University)

window.label_rule: goodware: target-class (0/1); ransomware CSVs: forced to 1

reproduce_windows: python sysmon_adapter.py --goodware data/raw/JamilIsp-RADAR-cb0c4c2/Raw logs/goodware/extracted/goodware-logs.csv --ransomware <62 family CSVs> --window-minutes 5 --goodware-sample 400000 --output data/radar_real_windows.csv
reproduce_metadata_windows: same as above with --include-metadata, output data/radar_real_windows_with_family.csv
